skills.name: ace
skills.description: Use when the user invokes Ace, asks an agent to own a substantial mission through measurable completion, or asks it to keep working until an outcome is verified. Ace may first bound an open-ended request. Do not use for one-step tasks, passive brainstorming, or indefinite improvement without agreement on an observable finish line.
skills.summary: Own a bounded mission through evidence-backed completion while preserving user judgment and authority.
